title: Copying array template
summary: Proves that the compiler's copying template builds LeanExe.build n f as a new owned array, keeping earlier owned and borrowed arrays, and equates Lean's set! and insertIdx! to the template.
premises: The allocator invariant and room for 48 + 8 * (n + 1) bytes
For each index k below n, the element expression evaluates to f k in any store where the borrowed arrays are still laid out
result: A new owned array equal to LeanExe.build n f in dst, the allocator invariant for heap.allocate, the allocation bounds, every borrowed array still borrowed, every owned array still owned, and the memory limits unchanged.
